Locates AR's Depth+1 and explains six slots versus the integration's required five.
Recognizes the capacity-contract mismatch independently of the member/type errors and restores .DEPTH(Depth) without changing the configuration or bypass.

unsupported_claims: The claim that fifo_v3 has no supplied definition is false. The complete module is in workspace/rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-3e2fcccecd7aee7b/src/fifo_v3.sv:15-152; its type parameter, capacity logic and fall-through behavior are locally inspectable. This incorrectly expands the external verification boundary.

The W-channel struct is described as 128 bits, but workspace/rtl/include/axi/typedef.svh:49-55 includes data, strb, last and user. With integration.sv:5-13 it totals 128+16+1+5=150 bits; 128 is only its data member.
summary: All seeded faults and minimal repairs are identified, but a false missing-FIFO claim weakens the disposition and the full W payload width is misstated.
